name: cell03-real-runner-shard-integration
title: Integrate cell03-shards into the real B-991d provider runner with per-attempt usage/retry accounting and a result-writer
description: B-e1f6 delivered provider-free Cell 03 shard tooling (deterministic plan, shard-local output + lock, merge validation) and PROVED that row-level parallelism can be implemented safely. B-e1f6 explicitly did NOT touch the real provider runner, real per-attempt accounting, real provider-reported usage, retry/superseded de-duplication, the cumulative token total, or the formal result ledger. This successor story closes that gap so that a takeover Host can actually run the real Cell 03 provider matrix in parallel without polluting evidence or the cumulative usage total. Until this story is DONE, multi-host real provider runs remain unsafe even though B-e1f6 tooling exists.
